title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the per-shipper allotment on one sailing
content:
## Rule
Every sailing carries a limited dangerous-goods allotment per shipper, so acceptances under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product are aggregated per customer per sailing. The containers of a new application or of an amendment, added to the containers the customer already has on that sailing as counted below, must not exceed the category's maximum containers per customer per sailing. An application or amendment that would exceed the allotment is refused for that sailing; the shipper may apply on another booking whose sailing has room. Rejected and withdrawn acceptances never count.

## How the containers already on the sailing are counted
1. The count is taken on the current state of the records on the handling date.
2. It covers the customer's acceptances of the same category on bookings allocated to the same vessel and voyage as the booking concerned.
3. Only acceptances whose status is submitted, under review or approved are included.
4. The acceptance being handled is left out.
5. The container counts of the included acceptances are totalled.

The test rests on the line's records — the customer on each acceptance, its booking, status and container count, and the vessel and voyage of each booking — and is made before the application or amendment is admitted. The customer and the sailing of the booking concerned are the two keys that tie the records together.

## Condition → outcome
| Containers already counted, plus the containers of the request | Outcome |
|---|---|
| total at or below the category's maximum | within the allotment |
| total above the category's maximum | refused for that sailing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical allotment of 9 containers)
- Already counted: 7. A new application for 2 containers brings the total to 9, which does not exceed 9: within the allotment.
- Already counted: 7. A new application for 3 containers brings the total to 10, which exceeds 9: refused for that sailing.

## Which acceptances enter the count
| Acceptance of the same customer, same category, same sailing | Counted |
|---|---|
| submitted | yes |
| under review | yes |
| approved | yes |
| rejected or withdrawn | no |
| loaded, discharged or closed | no — only the three statuses above are counted |
| an acceptance of another category, or on another sailing | no |

## Points of judgement
- *For an amendment, is the acceptance's own current container count added as well?* No. The acceptance being handled is left out of the count, and the containers of the amendment are added to what remains.
